text: Unlatched (2026-11-02): three Image References of one character (portrait, medium, wide) plus the sentence "the reference images show only who she is ... take nothing else from them - the room, the camera angle, the distance, her pose and the framing are new" did NOT lock composition on Sunburst: five new angles (overhead, floor-level, extreme close profile, far wide through a door) kept face, outfit and headphones. 17 credits at Small Low (8 + 3 per reference). The single-reference lock from Count Us All is a one-reference, no-instruction result.
